description: Implementation of A* pathfinding nodes and world management for the Wesnoth game, including node initialization, memory pooling, and spatial management.

classes.name: a_star_node
classes.description: Represents a node in the A* pathfinding algorithm, storing position, cost, heuristic, and parent node.

classes.name: a_star_world::poss_a_star_node
classes.description: Memory pool managing pre-allocated a_star_node objects for efficient reuse during pathfinding.

classes.name: a_star_world
classes.description: Manages the grid of nodes and provides methods for node retrieval, resizing, and clearing.

methods.name: a_star_node::initNode
methods.description: Initializes an A* node with position, destination, cost, parent, and teleport locations, adjusting heuristic accordingly.

methods.name: a_star_world::poss_a_star_node::addPage
methods.description: Allocates a new page of a_star_node objects for the memory pool.

methods.name: a_star_world::poss_a_star_node::poss_a_star_node
methods.description: Constructor initializing the memory pool with a default page size.

methods.name: a_star_world::poss_a_star_node::getAStarNode
methods.description: Retrieves a new or recycled a_star_node from the pool.

methods.name: a_star_world::poss_a_star_node::clear
methods.description: Resets the memory pool, freeing additional pages if allocated.

methods.name: a_star_world::a_star_world
methods.description: Constructor initializing the world and memory pool.

methods.name: a_star_world::~a_star_world
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up the memory pool.

methods.name: a_star_world::resize_IFN
methods.description: Resizes the node grid to specified width and height.

methods.name: a_star_world::clear
methods.description: Clears all nodes and resets the pathfinding grid.

methods.name: a_star_world::getNodeFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a node at a specific location, indicating if a new node was created.
